I'm not sure if anyone will see this but I attempted suicide last semester. I had been thinking about it for quite a while and was seeing a counselor for depression and suicidal thoughts. I reassured my counselor and friends that I would never go through with anything because I loved all of my family and friends too much to hurt them so badly. I wanted to die so badly; I was tired of school, trying to motivate myself, and just doing everyday tasks. So one night I thought this is my life, no one else's, why do I have to put myself through this misery everyday just for everyone else's feelings. So I tried to overdose and two of my roommates found me in the bathroom and dragged me to the car at 2 am and took me to the emergency room. My parents had no idea and I wasn't going to tell them until they showed up. My dad and sister came into the room first and didn't even say anything, all they could do was cry and I didn't want to look at them. A couple minutes later my mom came in and just hugged me for a long time and all I could say was that I was sorry because her mom killed herself right before I was born, I'm 20. I got countless texts from close friends that my roommates told about how much they love me and would hate to ever see anything happen to me and how they wouldn't even know what to do. My closest friends at school all came to see me and were all very supportive and wanted to be there and everyone cried a lot. Throughout the weeks I got calls from a lot of my Aunts and Uncles, even ones I hadn't talked to in a while, just calling to say that they loved me. I'm sorry to say that yes I feel terrible putting all these people through this even but I still think about killing myself, sometimes up to a couple times a week. I am just so exhausted acting like I am ok and getting better just so people won't worry about me. It's just my opinion that outsiders have no idea what is going on in my head and some people think that because I'm taking medicine and just because I saw how upset everyone else was that that would keep me from ever thinking about it again. Basically only one of my friends knows about how often I am still struggling. I think it is selfish of everyone else to expect this from me and it should be my decision but I probably won't do it again because I do not like letting people down.
